evidence.quote: The Starter variant of the Zeal Paladin meets the minimum gear requirements for farming the Starter ✔ tagged areas in the "Farming Spots" section below. These areas can be Solo-farmed by this setup (/Players1 on Single Player) in both Nightmare and Hell difficulty. An Upgraded Butcher's Pupil is a strong, relatively easy to acquire weapon that provides this build with sufficient power. There are several other low budget options that work just as well or nearly as well such as Unbending Will (see "Gear Options" below). Beyond a decently strong weapon, make sure to prioritize Attack Speed, Attack Rating, Damage, Damage Reduction, Resistances, Cannot Be Frozen, and Life/Attributes on your gear. A Teleport Charge Staff on Weapon-Swap allows this build to reposition. Follow the Paladin Leveling Guide to get your Paladin to Level 75.

evidence.quote: The Ubers variant specializes in defeating the Uber Bosses, including mini-Ubers such as Lilith. Crushing Blow, Open Wounds, Deadly Strike, Enhanced Damage, Damage Reduction, Resistances, and Life are priority stats on this setup. You can use a Teleport Charges Amulet for mobility to justify using Fortitude or Chains of Honor for more Damage and All Resistances. Exile, Dracul's Grasp, or a Life Tap Charges Wand provides a source of Life Tap for much needed Life Sustain. Pre-buffing Enchant with Demon Limb provides additional Attack Rating and pre-buffing Fade with Treachery provides Damage Reduction, Resistances, and Curse Duration Reduction. Thundergod's Vigor and stacked Lightning Resistance allow this build to tank Uber Mephisto. For extra swag, use Last Wish for its solid combination of Uber-killing stats.

evidence.quote: The Ubers variant specializes in defeating the Uber Bosses, including mini-Ubers such as Lilith. Crushing Blow, Open Wounds, Deadly Strike, Enhanced Damage, Damage Reduction, Resistances, and Life are priority stats on this setup. You can use a Teleport Charges Amulet for mobility to justify using Fortitude or Chains of Honor for more Damage and All Resistances. Exile, Dracul's Grasp, or a Life Tap Charges Wand provides a source of Life Tap for much needed Life Sustain. Pre-buffing Enchant with Demon Limb provides additional Attack Rating and pre-buffing Fade with Treachery provides Damage Reduction, Resistances, and Curse Duration Reduction. Thundergod's Vigor and stacked Lightning Resistance allow this build to tank Uber Mephisto. For extra swag, use Last Wish for its solid combination of Uber-killing stats.
